subject: general
question: The ratio of the outer and the inner circumference of a circular path is 17 ∶ 15. If path is 40 metres wide, then what is the radius of the inner circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of circumferences of two circles is identical to the ratio of their radii.

Ratio of outer radius (R) to inner radius (r) = 17 ∶ 15

Width of the path in ratio units = 17 − 15 = 2 units.

Given width = 40 metres, so 2 units = 40 metres ⇒ 1 unit = 20 metres.

Inner radius = 15 units = 15 × 20 = 300 metres.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of outer and inner circumference = 17 ∶ 15

Width of the path = 40 metres

**Formula Used:**

Circumference of a circle = 2×π×r

Width of circular path = R − r

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/901a6739e9dc59f8882b395fec41f837af89839e1d5def8de74be8db74beb14f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the outer radius be R and the inner radius be r.

⇒ Ratio of circumferences = (2×π×R) ÷ (2×π×r)

⇒ R / r = 17 / 15

⇒ Let R = 17x and r = 15x

⇒ Width of the circular path = Outer Radius − Inner Radius

⇒ 17x − 15x = 40

⇒ 2x = 40

⇒ x = 20

⇒ Inner radius (r) = 15x = 15 × 20 = 300 metres

**∴ The correct answer is 300 metres.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Circular Path

The total area located strictly between two concentric circles is given by Area = π×(R² − r²), where R and r are the respective outer and inner radii.

Length of an Arc

An arc is a fraction of the full circumference. The length is determined by the central angle θ: (θ ÷ 360) × 2πr.

Area of a Sector

The region bounded by two radii and an adjoining arc is called a sector. Its area is: (θ ÷ 360) × πr².
